JKPSC Prelims Result 2026 Out: The JKPSC CCE Result 2025 for the Prelims Exam was announced on 22nd January 2026. The exam was held on 7th December 2025. Candidates who have qualified the Prelims have been shortlisted for the Mains Exam. The Jammu & Kashmir Public Service Commission is conducting the JKPSC CCE 2025 Exam to recruit candidates for 80 vacancies under the J&K Administrative Service, KAS, Police Service, and Administrative Services. Get the JKPSC Result download link, steps to download, release date, and other details here.

JKPSC Prelims Result 2025-26 Out @jkpsc.nic.in

The JKPSC Prelims Result 2025 was announced online @jkpsc.nic.in.  Based on their performance in the Prelims, candidates have been shortlisted for the Mains. The schedule for the Mains Exam will be announced soon. Candidates can check their results from the commission’s official website.

 JKPSC CCE Prelims Result 2025
Exam Name JKPSC Combined Competitive Exam (JKPSC CCE)
Exam Conducting Body Jammu & Kashmir Public Service Commission (JKPSC)
Official Website jkpsc.nic.in
Exam Stages Prelims, Mains, Interview
Prelims Date 7th December 2025
JKPSC Prelims Result Release Date 22nd January 2026

 JKPSC Prelims Result 2025 PDF Download

The JKPSC CCE Prelims Result PDF 2025-26 is now available on the JKPSC official website  It contains the roll number-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the JKPSC CCE Mains Exam. You can visit the commission’s official website or use the direct link to download the JKPSC Result 2025 PDF.

Download JKPSC Prelims Result 2025 PDF

Steps to Download JKPSC Prelims Result 2026

The JKPSC Result 2026 is available in the form of a PDF on the commission’s website. Candidates who took the exam can check the result and know their qualifying status for further selection.  To download the JKPSC Prelims Result 2025-26 from the commission’s website, follow the steps mentioned below.

Step 1. Go to the JKPSC website @jkpsc.nic.in.

Step 2. From the ‘What’s New’ section, click the JKPSC Prelims Result PDF download link

Step 3. The result will be displayed on your screen.

Step 4. Find your Roll Number in the JKPSC CCE Result PDF.

Step 5. Download and save the result PDF for your reference.

Details Mentioned on the JKPSC Result 2026

The JKPSC CCE Prelims Result PDF contains the roll number-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Mains. In addition, it also has the following important details, which candidates must cross-check carefully to avoid discrepancies later.

  • Name of the Exam
  • Exam Stage
  • Exam Date
  • Roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • Instructions for the further selection process.

What’s Next After the JKPSC Prelims Result is Announced?

Once the JKPSC Prelims Result is announced, the shortlisted candidates must start preparing for the Mains Exam. Candidates need to apply for the Mains Exam separately. The notification for the same will be released separately. After the Mains Exam, the candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview. The final JKPSC Merit List will be prepared based on the scores of the Mains Exam & Interview.

What is the JKPSC Mains Exam Date 2025

The JKPSC CCE Prelims Result for the ongoing 2025 cycle has been announced. The qualified candidates must now start preparing for the mains. The JKPSC Mains Exam Dates will be announced shortly. Candidates can regularly visit the official website for updates about the same.

We hope these details about the JKPSC Prelims Result 2025 were informative. To prepare for other state and central government exams, download the Testbook App, which has PYPs, mock tests, online classes, and more.

FAQs on JKPSC Result 2026

Ques. When was the JKPSC Prelims Result 2025 announced?

Ans. The JKPSC CCE Prelims Result 2025-26 was announced on 22nd January 2026

Ques. Where can I find the JKPSC Result 2025 PDF for the Prelims?

Ans. You can find the JKPSC Prelims Result PDF on the commission’s website @jkpsc.nic.in.

Ques. What is the JKPSC Mains Exam Date 2026?

Ans. The JKPSC Mains Exam Dates for the JKPSC CCE 2025 will be announced later.
